topIssues.title: dispute-mon: Migrate to supernode APIs
topIssues.author: Inphi
topIssues.body:
Replace supervisor API usage in dispute-mon with supernode APIs. Although the supernode API isn't fully implemented yet, there aren't e2e tests in dispute-mon that depends on a concrete implementation so it's OK to completely replace the supervisor client.

The dispute-mon config flags should be updated for supernode use.

topPRs.title: fix(op-batcher): fix loop in batcher with shadow compressor+brotli
topPRs.author: bearpebble
topPRs.body:
**Description**
When using op-batcher with shadow compressor and brotli, there is a bug that makes the batcher submit empty batches in a loop. The code that is supposed to handle the case of single large blocks assumes that if any bytes have been written to the compressor before, there must be at least one block already.
https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/blob/ff51a4a203bd920c4e3bfd18a26af811369c69de/op-batcher/compressor/shadow_compressor.go#L72-L79

However, that assumption is no longer true with the introduction of brotli compression because it writes a version byte when creating a new channel compressor.
https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/blob/ff51a4a203bd920c4e3bfd18a26af811369c69de/op-node/rollup/derive/channel_compressor.go#L82-L90

My suggested fix is to add on overload to the channel compressors to allow declaring the number of static bytes used by the compressor. I'm open to other suggestions as well though.

**Tests**

I've added a test for this scenario that fails prior to the fix.

**Additional context**

Another consideration is whether we want to detect the kind of loop where no blocks are added.

https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/blob/ff51a4a203bd920c4e3bfd18a26af811369c69de/op-batcher/batcher/channel_manager.go#L429-L433

We could do a sanity check here if we expose the block count in the current channel.
Let me know if I should implement this as well.
```
if errors.As(err, &_chFullErr) {
  // channel is full. sanity check that we have at least one block
  // in the channel as otherwise we would be stuck in a loop here
  if s.currentChannel.BlockCount() == 0 {
    panic(fmt.Sprintf("single block[%d] led to full channel without blocks", block.NumberU64()))
  }
  // current block didn't get added because channel is already full
  break
}
```

topPRs.title: test(contracts): improve DisputeMonitorHelper test coverage
topPRs.author: devin-ai-integration
topPRs.body:
# test(contracts): improve DisputeMonitorHelper test coverage

## Summary

Enhances the `DisputeMonitorHelper` test suite by converting focused tests to fuzz tests and adding edge case coverage:

- **toRpcHexString**: Added edge case test for zero value (`0x0`) and fuzz test verifying output prefix format
- **search**: Converted `test_search_olderThanEverything_succeeds` and `test_search_newerThanEverything_succeeds` to proper fuzz tests with bounded timestamp parameters
- **getUnresolvedGames**: Converted `test_getUnresolvedGames_betweenTimestamps_succeeds` to fuzz test with parameterized timestamps and gap

The original tests used `vm.randomUint()` internally but weren't parameterized fuzz tests. Converting them to proper fuzz tests with `bound()` constraints provides broader coverage across the input space.

## Review & Testing Checklist for Human

- [ ] Verify the bound constraints in fuzz tests are appropriate (e.g., `type(uint64).max - 1` for newer search to allow +1 without overflow)
- [ ] Run `just test-dev --match-path test/periphery/monitoring/DisputeMonitorHelper.t.sol -v` to confirm all 16 tests pass

### Notes

- All tests passed locally (16 tests, 0 failures)
- No production code changes - test-only modifications
- Link to Devin run: https://app.devin.ai/sessions/9da777165afc48ceb1d43ff7f9c6a2df
- Requested by: Ariel Diaz (@aliersh)
